subject: Evaluation kickoff & calendar sync: MedPert trial
messages:
From: Samantha Reid <samantha@medpert.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood evaluation: follow-up & kickoff timing

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call earlier — that was helpful for us to understand how Redwood approaches reliability and cost controls for clinical NLP workloads. Quick recap and two asks from our side:

- Goal: run a 4-week evaluation to validate throughput and hallucination rate on our anonymized clinical notes.
- Success criteria we care about: (1) average latency under 300ms for 128-token outputs, (2) precision@5 for entity extraction above 92%, and (3) stable cost per 1k tokens within your quoted range.

Ask 1: Can we schedule the evaluation kickoff (demo + ops deep dive) next week? We're looking for a 60–90 minute slot that includes both a product demo and a technical handoff for our infra/security folks.

Ask 2: I'll need a short evaluation plan and a sample prompt set so my team can prep. If you can send those as attachments that’d help. Also please include any SOC 2 / data handling notes up front — our procurement will ask.

Proposed attendees on our side: myself (Lead PM), Raj Patel (SRE), and Leah Morgan (Head of Data).

Best,
Samantha

Samantha Reid
Product Lead, MedPert
samantha@medpert.com
(415) 555-0198

[Attachment: none yet]

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Reid <samantha@medpert.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-12T12:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood evaluation: follow-up & kickoff timing

Hi Samantha — great to meet you on the call. Thanks for outlining the success criteria; those are clear and align with how we measure trial health.

I'm copying Ben (Solutions) and Lauren (CS) so we can coordinate the technical deep dive and the evaluation logistics. Attached is a short evaluation plan (eval-plan-v0.1.pdf) and a starter prompt pack (prompt-pack.xlsx) you can share with Leah and Raj.

Two quick scheduling options next week for a 75-minute kickoff (demo + tech handoff + Q/A):
- Tue 2027-04-13 10:00–11:15 PT
- Wed 2027-04-14 14:00–15:15 PT

If neither works, please propose two slots and we’ll do our best to accommodate. For the kickoff agenda, we suggest:
1) 15 min product demo (high-level workflows)
2) 30 min technical deep dive (infra, network, data flow)
3) 20 min prompt/playbook review + sample evals
4) 10 min next steps & rollout plan

I'll also include a short SOC 2 summary and the link to our security FAQ in a follow-up email.

Attachments:
- eval-plan-v0.1.pdf (stub)
- prompt-pack.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — I’ll hold the two slots and we can confirm once you pick one.

Cheers,
Irene

Hi Samantha — thanks for the note and for sharing attendees. Quick technical note from our side: if Raj can join the deep dive, please have him bring any network diagrams or firewall rules so we can run through required ports and IP allowlists (we'll also share our recommended VPC peering options).

One more slot that might work for our infra engineers:
- Thu 2027-04-15 09:30–10:45 PT

If Leah/Raj have timezone constraints, happy to prioritize the earlier Wed slot Irene suggested. Also, Lauren and I will prepare an initial prompt-to-eval mapping so you can see which prompts we'll run for precision/recall checks.

Cheers,
